name: ProsPilot API
description: ProsPilot — independent community-built DeFi copilot for the Pharos ecosystem (chain 1672). Not an official Pharos Network product. RAG knowledge, read-only quotes, wallet intel. Non-custodial.

Read-only LI.FI quote for a token swap on Pharos or a bridge to Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum/Polygon/Optimism. Returns estimate + unsigned transactionRequest.
